mapper.select: SELECT d.id document_id, d.parse_version, IF(d.deleted=0 AND s.deleted=0 AND d.parse_status='READY',1,0) ready FROM document d LEFT JOIN space s ON s.id=d.space_id WHERE d.id=#{documentId}
SELECT t.document_id FROM document_vector_task t LEFT JOIN document d ON d.id=t.document_id WHERE d.id IS NULL AND t.target_signature<>'deleted' ORDER BY t.document_id LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_vector_task( document_id, generation, target_signature, target_parse_version, state, attempts, next_attempt_ms, lease_until_ms, claim_token, active_generation, active_parse_version, active_collection, stale_collection, active_chunk_count, cleanup_pending ) VALUES ( #{documentId}, 1, #{signature}, (SELECT d.parse_version FROM document d WHERE d.id=#{documentId}), 'PENDING', 0, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE generation=generation+IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),1,0), target_parse_version=IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),VALUES(target_parse_version),target_parse_version), state=IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),'PENDING',state), attempts=IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),0,attempts), next_attempt_ms=IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),0,next_attempt_ms), lease_until_ms=IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),0,lease_until_ms), claim_token=IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),NULL,claim_token), error_code=IF(target_signature<>VALUES(target_signature),NULL,error_code), target_signature=VALUES(target_signature)
mapper.update: UPDATE document_vector_task SET stale_collection = CASE WHEN active_collection IS NOT NULL AND (#{activeCollection} IS NULL OR active_collection <> #{activeCollection}) THEN active_collection ELSE stale_collection END, state = 'DONE', active_generation = #{generation}, active_parse_version = #{targetParseVersion}, active_collection = #{activeCollection}, active_chunk_count = #{writtenCount}, cleanup_pending = 1, claim_token = NULL, lease_until_ms = 0, error_code = NULL WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND generation = #{generation} AND state = 'PENDING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND lease_until_ms > #{nowMs} AND active_generation < #{generation} AND ((#{targetParseVersion} IS NULL AND target_parse_version IS NULL) OR target_parse_version = #{targetParseVersion})
